name: Alan Crawford
original_name: アラン・クロフォード
source:
Captain Alyn Crawford protects the royal house from the fore of the Royal Wysterian Guard, the superlative order of knighthood. His haughty demeanor is rivaled only by an overwhelming fixation to his duty...
